sentences.text:
======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Raghav Prasad, Advocate
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Ahmad Ali, App
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Harish Kumar
 Oral Order
19-10-2023 Heard Mr. Raghav Prasad, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Guthani P.S. Case No. 247 of 2022,
registered for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468 and 471 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 30(a) of Bihar Prohibition and Excise Act.

3. The police in course of vehicle checking intercepted a truck bearing Registration No.
UP-25DT-6782.
In course of search total 1913.400 liters of Indian Made Foreign Liquor was recovered.
The driver and khalasi of the truck was apprehended at the spot who disclosed the name of the petitioner as the owner of the truck.

4. It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.64770 of 2023(2) dt.19-10-2023 petitioner has been made accused in this case in the capacity of he being owner of truck.

It is the fact that the truck was being used for purposes transportation of goods and at no point of time the petitioner has ever been allowed the driver and khalasi to use it for transportation of any illegal goods.
Moreover, the petitioner has neither any concern with the illicit wine nor the consigner and consignee of the same.
He next submits that the petitioner is man of fair antecedent and he undertakes that he will fully cooperate in the investigation and in the proceeding of the Court.
He lastly submits that so far the driver and the cleaner are concerned they have been allowed regular bail by a Bench of this Court.

sentences.text: 1 5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State opposes the bail application and submits that a huge consignment of illicit wine has been recovered from the truck in question of which the petitioner is said to be the owner.

6. Regard being had to the submissions made on behalf of the parties and considering the fact that the petitioner has been made accused in this case in the capacity of owner of the truck in question coupled with his fair antecedent and the undertaking given before this Court, let the petitioner abovenamed be released on bail, in the event of his arrest or Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.64770 of 2023(2) dt.19-10-2023 surrender before the court below within a period of four weeks from the date of receipt/production of a copy of this order, upon furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 25,000/-
(twenty thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Special Excise Court No. 1, Siwan in connection with Guthani P.S. Case No. 247 of 2022, subject to the conditions laid down in Section 438(2) Cr.P.C. with the further condition that one of the bailors shall be the own/close family members of the petitioner.

(Harish Kumar, J) saurabhkr/-
